non_findings.claim: 79c65c4903e72ee2 custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/price_model.py:232 CLAMP_DROP: equivalent through production (full gate RED-AS-NULL). Every production path leaves the EWMA'd shape's mean >= 0.12 x SHAPE_MIN > 1e-6 (observe_day clips the day to [0.2, 3] and from_dict's _in_domain keeps stored bins positive), so the floor never binds: one day, two days, spiky days and from_dict-restored negative/zero/tiny rows give identical shapes in both arms. Only a model hand-built with a negative stored shape (bypassing from_dict) separates them.

cee6857510fbe69e custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/price_model.py:275 CLAMP_DROP: equivalent through production (full gate RED-AS-NULL). Every production path keeps each hour's EWMA'd factors positive (an hour with mean <= 1e-6 gets factor 1.0, others are clipped to [0.25, 4]; from_dict's _in_domain repairs stored rows), so the hour mean never drops below 0.25 x 0.12 and the floor never binds: a zero-price hour, a negative hour after a normal day, spike/zero sequences and from_dict-restored negative/zero rows give identical factors in both arms. The carried M4 answer ('an hour whose quarter factors average 0') is not reachable: the usable mask sets such an hour to 1.0. Only a hand-built model with negative stored factors separates.
